items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I ran into Herbie and he had a guy with him that was going to be his manager--Pete something, who became Monty Kay's partner--Pete Cameron.

ctx.x: I was discharged from there, came back in time to run into a guy who I had associated myself with just before I went to the army, a saxophone player named Herbie Fields. I had once told Herbie that if he ever wanted to be a band leader, I'd be happy to write a book for him. I thought he should be a band leader, I felt he had the ability to front a band.
I was still in uniform and I ran into Herbie and he had a guy with him that was going to be his manager--Pete something, who

became Monty Kay's partner--Pete Cameron. We got together and we decided to create a band for Herbie to front. I spent some time with that, we developed a book and we auditioned for a few hotels; we never quite got going, but we had a pretty good little band after a while.
